parsed.root_cause: The payment service is configured to fail 100% of charge requests due to the 'paymentFailure' feature flag being set to '100%', causing a cascade of errors across dependent services.
evidence: The ConfigMap 'flagd-config' (object [4]) shows the 'paymentFailure' flag variant set to '100%', whereas the baseline (object [2]) has it set to 'off'.
Multiple alerts indicate high request error rates in the 'payment', 'checkout', and 'frontend' services within the 'otel-demo' namespace.
Trace data (object [10]) shows an HTTP 503 error originating from the 'frontend-proxy' when accessing the product API, consistent with a backend failure chain initiated by the payment service.
